> Item 5 (kernel icache maintenance), K5 note: per K5-q-icache, K5 owns the single-hart piece.
> - The kernel will run fence.i after any call that installs or adds an executable mapping (process_map, map_anon, map_fixed, set_flags) and once at boot before the first user dispatch. The argument is in QA K5-plan v1.6.
> - The multi-hart piece is NOT K5's and stays with post-M1 SMP (PLAN, SMP): fence.i on other harts when X is installed, and on the destination hart at thread migration (or SBI remote fence.i).
> - The stub's own fence.i stays; it's harmless and correct.
